_source: Hand-curated from verified web research as of 2026-07-24 — see docs/FOOTBALL-HUB.md. No 2026-27 league-phase table exists yet (draw is 27 Aug 2026); nothing here is fabricated as a live standing.

season2526.result: PSG won 4-3 on penalties after a 3-3 draw (a.e.t.)
season2526.note: PSG became the first club to retain the trophy since Real Madrid in 2016-17, despite finishing outside the top 8 of the 36-team league phase and winning it through the knockout playoff route. Arsenal topped the league phase in 1st place. Vitinha was named Man of the Match.

season2627.format: 36-team single league phase — every club plays 8 opponents (4 home, 4 away), drawn from seeding pots. Top 8 advance directly to the round of 16; 9th-24th enter a two-legged knockout play-off for the remaining 8 spots; bottom 12 are eliminated.

season2627.note: Five English clubs qualified for 2026-27 — an extra slot earned via England's UEFA coefficient ranking, on top of the usual top-4.
